SELECT t.id, t.category_id, t.title, t.cover_url, t.sort_order FROM templates t
WHERE t.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id
JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id, t.sort_order, t.id

SELECT t.id, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, t.title, t.description, t.cover_url, t.sample_result_path, t.required_image_count, t.accepted_mime_types, t.max_file_size_bytes, t.sort_order FROM templates t JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
